title: Make authentication mandatory in mcpHttpServer.ts setupMiddlewares
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server (repo OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server, branch main, inspected at aaa72a040db4c32f3d6488d5e28e2892a68e9ee0), replace the opt-in header loop in src/transports/mcpHttpServer.ts setupMiddlewares() (lines 306-319) with a fail-closed authentication gate on every /mcp route (POST/GET/DELETE, lines 360-411). Right now the loop only runs over userConfig.httpHeaders, which defaults to {} (src/common/config/userConfig.ts 136-143). Requirements: (a) mount the auth middleware before express.json so unauthenticated bodies are never parsed; (b) accept a bearer token (Authorization: Bearer) or a configured secret header credential, checked with crypto.timingSafeEqual on equal-length buffers instead of the current `header !== value`; (c) when neither is configured, reject every request with 401 and a WWW-Authenticate header; (d) add a userConfig key for the token, loaded from an environment variable and marked isSecret in server.json, with no default value; (e) treat mcp-session-id only as a routing key, never as a credential. No secret values may appear in the repo, tests or this workspace; use secret-manager locators. The CTO's engineering team implements it (sdlc/policy.json owner: cto) under this task's owner.
acceptanceCriteria: With no auth configuration, `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}'` against a locally started server returns 401 (not 200 or a JSON-RPC response), and GET and DELETE /mcp also return 401.
With a token configured, a request with the wrong token or wrong length returns 401/403, and a request with the correct token completes MCP initialize successfully.
`grep -n 'timingSafeEqual' src/transports/mcpHttpServer.ts` finds the comparison, and `grep -n 'header !== value' src/transports/mcpHttpServer.ts` finds nothing.

Re-running probe-schemas on mongodb-mcp-server at the merged commit does not produce SCH-API-01 at src/transports/mcpHttpServer.ts (fingerprint 2b47a8fb3b6e3225e8b94541ffb4b7c068f7cb9440d9d22aa3c053fe690a20a6).

verificationMethod.description: After updating applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server.json pinnedCommit to the merge commit, run /probe-schemas example-co --app mcp-gateway. Expected: the SARIF export has no failing SCH-API-01 result for src/transports/mcpHttpServer.ts, and the ledger observation for sebi-cscrf-2024:PR.AA.S17 on this repo is satisfied.

rootCause.description: The HTTP transport never had an authentication control. The only gate is a header-equality loop over userConfig.httpHeaders, which defaults to an empty object, so the middleware calls next() for every request unless an operator opts in.
